name: Phase Shift #12
description: Phase Shift #12 is a techno and dub techno event in Porto, featuring a secret line-up. The event encourages attendees to focus on the moment by prohibiting phone use and scrolling.
longDescription:
Phase Shift #12 is a techno and dub techno event taking place on Saturday, November 21, 2026, from 6:00 PM to 2:00 AM. The event is held at Avenida da Boavista 581, 4100-127 Porto, Portugal.

The line-up for Phase Shift #12 remains secret, and attendees are asked to avoid using phones during the event to encourage being present in the moment. Tickets are available in two releases: the 1st Release costs €7.50, and the 2nd Release costs €10.00. Tickets can be resold on the Shotgun app if needed.
